quest.title: Shuumatsuban Operations
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, what was with that person just now? The road's wide enough. They didn't have to walk straight at us like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No "sorry" or "excuse Paimon" either. They just walked right off!

choices.text: Things aren't quite that simple, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? This is... a small note? You mean that person slipped it onto you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Quick, let's open it and see what it says!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The note has an image of a shuriken on it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, nothing to read over here. Just a windmill and a window.

choices.text: I think it might be depicting some other things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... You're right! Hmm, let Paimon think... A shuriken, huh... Ooh, that's right! It's the "Shuumatsuban"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it now! This must be a coded message from Ms. Gendou. In that case, this "metal gate" has to be the entrance to her safehouse!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: More or less.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's head over to the safehouse. That's where Ms. Gendou's gotta be!

choices.text: You mean a shuriken and a metal gate?
I discovered this on my person.

talks.objective: Head for the safehouse to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing much.

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: See you, then. If you wish to know more about Lyudochka, you can ask the others.

talks.objective: Go to the safehouse to look for Gendou Ringo

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Well, look who's here. What? You've been staring since you came in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Ms. Gendou, you look really different from before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did something change while we were out of contact? Don't worry, we'll do our best to help you out!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Changes? What are you talking about? Hmph. Forget worrying about me. You're the ones who were completely defenseless out there on the street.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, that's the Gendou Ringo we know.

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: What are you two yammering about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, nothing, nothing! It's just good to see that you're well...

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: Hmph. For us ninja, every appearance is a disguise. I have a new mission now, so of course I no longer need that restrictive shrine maiden uniform.

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: Anyway, "Gendou Ringo" is still being used by that fake at the Grand Narukami Shrine, so use my new codename, "Momoyo." Got it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Roger, Ms. Momoyo!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Roger, Ms. Momoyo!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: ...Whatever. Now, back on topic. There is a reason why I haven't contacted you recently.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what happened?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: I guessed previously that the fake Gendou infiltrated the Shrine because she believed you to be Shuumatsuban members, and was thus preparing to infiltrate the Shuumatsuban itself.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Logically, she should be trying to contact you often, which will push the plan forward. But things have been oddly quiet there recently.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. She hasn't given us any missions in quite a while.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Experience tells me that the Fatui must be "experiencing some changes" themselves. Perhaps they are planning to launch some truly large-scale operation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That would be terrible!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: That's why I looked for you today. I'm giving you a mission: figure out what the fake Gendou and the Fatui are plotting.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Should we actively seek her out?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: No need. Let's not stir them up just yet.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Recently, we discovered three other undercover Fatui. Disguise yourself as one of their comrades and try to coax some intel out of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehhh? That's a super hard mission! How could you talk about it in such a relaxed manner?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Oh, quit complaining. I've already figured it out for you. Here, take this code sheet.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Code sheet?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: That's right. The Fatui's modus operandi differs greatly depending on which Harbinger they're under. This latest batch uses codes to ascertain their common allegiance.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: The codes they commonly use are written here. Take it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds super cool. Let Paimon see, let Paimon see!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, so many of these words are more like scrawls, and there's water damage too. Paimon can barely read it!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Water? Huh, might've been saliva, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—Saliva!?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Hmph. You'd best know that I somehow managed to snag that infiltration-specialist shortie to get this done. In fact, I'm impressed she actually managed to stay awake long enough to catch this much.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I think I know who you're talking about.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: Whatever the case, memorize those codes, and the rest is up to you. Adapt, improvise, and overcome!

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: One of your three targets is <color=#00E1FFFF>disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: The other two operate in Inazuma City. <color=#00E1FFFF>One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, started working in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs very recently</color>. Got that?

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: I'll be here in the safehouse for a few more days, preparing fake cadavers for a mission.

response.speaker: Momoyo
response.text: I've already marked the Fatui's locations out on the map. Go, and return quickly!

choices.text: Ah, this familiar, horrible tone of voice...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing much.

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll rest up a bit further before going back to work. Working at a hot spring really makes you dizzy... That's how I let my Cryo abilities slip by mistake previously.

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission hasn't stopped suspecting me over that, even now.

talks.objective: Win the trust of the spy in Ritou

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Attempt to make contact.

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: Hello? Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, we're actually...

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Hmm? Oh, I get it. You mean that you're also outlanders living in Ritou, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(Uh, so he seems friendly enough, but Paimon thinks you got that one a teensy bit wrong, {NICKNAME}.)

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Sorry. Could you leave me alone for a while? I'd like to rest for a few days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Looks like he doesn't trust us. We should study the codes we were given one more time.)

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Oh? You seem pretty young, but you're "fellow countrymen," huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't you underestimate us!

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: How long have you been in Inazuma? Have you gotten used to life here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not long, really, but we're doing alright.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Good, good. Well, I suppose you've met those "General Crabs," then? Those people really know how to give us trouble.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: No kidding. Taxes used to be the worst thing ever around here in Ritou. They've actually gone down quite a lot after the recent abolition of the Vision Hunt Decree.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: On the downside... *sigh* You know what? It's probably due to that incident with our Lady. Vigilance is at an all-time high. We can't act rashly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ("Our Lady"... He must mean Signora.)

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Well, let's leave the "General Crabs" aside first. Those "Iron Rats" are also getting harder to deal with.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: I just came back from a "hike," so I'll probably spend some time here in Ritou "sunbathing." I mean, we've really got a great "north wind" blowing!

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Celebrating? Why, thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Uh, Paimon thinks you said something wrong. His expression's darkening.)

choices.text: That's terrible. You've had it rough, I see.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: *sigh* Thanks. I've heard that many of our "fellow countrymen" have gone to "wash the dishes." Who knows how long we can stay here ourselves?

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Speaking of which, the Teacher did mention that there would be a few new members coming in to work with Lyudochka. You must be one of them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: I see! Ah, I'm sorry. I've been on edge lately, that's why I tested the two of you for so long.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: I mean, of course you're one of us, that should have been obvious. You were so familiar with our codes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(This is great, {NICKNAME}, looks like he totally trusts us now!)

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: What do you need from me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To be honest, we'd like to know a bit more about the "fellow countryman" you called Lyudochka.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Exactly. We have to work together, after all.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: I see. To be honest, I've never seen her either. I just know that she's infiltrated the Grand Narukami Shrine atop Mt. Yougou.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Ah, she's so lucky. We were all brought up in similar circumstances, but it's just easier for people with Inazuman blood like her to create a fake identity, you know?

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Those who look like outlanders no matter how you slice it, like me, can only stay here in Ritou.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do people say anything else about her?

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Well, they certainly all think she's been fortunate to get a safe and relaxing job like "being a shrine maiden." But there are also those who are jealous of her position.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so that's how it is?

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Exactly. She's in an excellent position, but her infiltration mission hasn't progressed at all. It seems like the Teacher's patience is wearing thin.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: As such, the Teacher's decided to transfer her to an active unit so that she can make some actual contributions to the cause. She'll be out in the field with people like you.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: You needn't worry, though. They say she's never been in a real fight, but that she was pretty sharp in training. Between the two of you, you should be able to get some big things done.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: I can't be sure about much else, I'm afraid. You can ask the others. Just be prepared. You might get a cold reception from those who are ill-disposed toward Lyudochka.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Do you two have anything else you need to know?

choices.text: Aye, what with the robberies and all.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Robbery? Surely you jest. They're with the Shogunate. Surely they wouldn't do such things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Uh oh, he's getting suspicious! You must've mixed up the lines that were related to crabs!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(Oh, come on, {NICKNAME}, that's clearly not the right line!)

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: "Fellow conspirator," you say? That's quite the sense of humor you've got there. I suppose you, too, must be an outlander living in Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I'm with the "Iron Rats."

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: What—! You're... with the Shuumatsuban!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right — and we're going to put an "end" to you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know, we're actually...

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: Wait. So you really *are* with Lyudochka, aren't you!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! That's exactly it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon, that's not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatever! The way she keeps talking about other people just ticks Paimon off! Even Lyudochka wasn't this annoying!

talks.objective: Win the trust of the spy in Inazuma City

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Attempt to make contact with him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty easy to find, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: ...What is it? You want to fight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, don't misunderstand. We've got something to ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: ...Ask me? Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, we're...

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: "Story?"

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: A man has no story. Only friends... or enemies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Wow. This guy's actually kinda cool... But come on, the code you gave was obviously wrong.)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: ...Hmph.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Looks like he isn't bothering with us anymore. We've got to pay more attention to those codes.)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: "Failure"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(What are you saying, {NICKNAME}!? That's way too far off the mark!)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Ha... Hahaha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Look at his face, just look at that scary mug! Please stop using the wrong codes!)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: No, no! Failure only comes when people "loosen their left hands."

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: That is why we must "clench our left hands." Yes, that's right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (...Hmm, he seems to be off in his own world. Doesn't look like he's in the mood to bother with us right now.)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: "Fellow countrymen" from the homeland... You're new?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, that's right. That's why we came to say hello.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: I see. Then, have you heard?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heard about what?

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: The "General Crabs" and "Sun Crabs," "clenched their right hands"... Our "fellow countrymen" went "hiking," encountered the "north wind."

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Mm. The Teacher says that we must "smash the plates."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Honestly, Paimon's feeling kinda lost already, but at least he seems pleased with what you said.)

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Also, that woman. She must be tested.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That woman?

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Lyudochka. Our "fellow countryman" at the shrine. She has been "sunbathing" all this time.

choices.text: So you suspect that she's "loosened her left hand"?

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Yes. Exactly. That.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Speak. What do you want?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, we'd like to know a bit more about what's going on with Lyudochka.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Lyudochka? Hmph. She is weak.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: But she knows Inazuma. Well. The Teacher gave her an important task. But she has disappointed.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Tonight. The Teacher will meet her. And give her orders. It will be at the usual place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The "usual place"? Where's that supposed to be?

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: I do not know. Nor do I care. I only know that she is "Snezhevna." So the Teacher has been good to her.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: She must "smash the plates." Repay that debt.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: Anything else?

choices.text: So you suspect that she's "loosened her right hand"?

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: You... Very suspicious.

response.speaker: Fujita
response.text: You smiled. Why? Are you... an enemy?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No, no, {F#she}{M#he} was just about to sneeze, that's all! We'll talk to you again later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (That was way too dangerous! You really ticked him off back there. Did he confuse you by using too many code words?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, we're with the Shuumatsuban.

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: So you are enemies. We must destroy the enemy. We must "clench our left hands"!

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: I took my eyes off her for a moment, and now she's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: Oh, my apologies. Do you need my help with something, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could we ask if you've hired a new employee recently? We'd just like to ask her a few things.

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: Oh, you must be referring to Tae. As it happens, I'm looking for her too.

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: She isn't very focused at work, and even skips out on her shift quite often. I bet she's hiding out somewhere right now, taking a break.

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: Somehow, there was an incident of a guest getting frostbite while she was on shift. So yes, she's a headache. In fact, I wonder if it might be better if she didn't come to work at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: I don't think she'll have gone far. She should be slacking off in the courtyard by the cliff.

talks.objective: Win the trust of the spy at the hot springs

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Attempt to make contact with her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've got something to ask you...

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: Hmm? Who are you? Did that Mikawa Akane send you? Pfah. I just skipped a shift. You don't have to call people to catch me. Ugh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you've got it wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: What, are you from the Tenryou Commission, then? I already told you. I was on duty that day, yes, but I've got nothing to do with that case of frostbite, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we're not from the Tenryou Commission either. We're...

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: What? So you're "fellow countrymen"? You should've just said so!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you didn't let us speak earlier...

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: What? Are you trying to start a fight with me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, definitely not!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Ugh, and here Paimon thought that Momoyo had a terrible temper. This Fatui lady might be even worse...!)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hmph. "Fellow countrymen," eh? If you've got nothing else to do, get out of my way.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: This job is tiring as all get-out, and there's not a moment of peace and quiet to be found. Archon, I might as well go "wash the dishes"!

choices.text: Well, that might not be a bad thing.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Huh? What did you say? If you've got nothing good to say, then get lost!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Oh no, you misunderstood the meaning of that code word. She looks super angry right now!)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Get out of my face until you know what you're talking about!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (She seems pretty annoyed. We've gotta study those codes more carefully.)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: *sigh* ...You're right. Working here at the hot spring is tiring, yes, but at least for now, the "south wind" is blowing.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hah, and what's more, I need to stick around long enough to watch that woman, slacking off at the shrine as she is, get her comeuppance!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Comeuppance?

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: That's right! That Lyudochka and her archon-forsaken good luck... Believe you me, I've never liked that wretch!

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: I could've been the one to work at the shrine, but the Teacher chose her in the end... Hmph. We're all "Snezhevnas." How am I inferior to her in any way, huh?

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: And what do you think of that woman, huh? Will you "clench your right hand" or "loosen your right hand"?

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Tch. What, are you two on good terms or something? What did you come find me for, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (To "clench your right hand" means to "make an alliance." She might not suspect that we're not Fatui, but she probably thinks we've taken the fake Gendou's side...)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Tsk, you're useless. Just hanging around people like you makes me sick.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Huh... to "loosen the right hand" means to "forgive." Ugh, she's looking down on us!)

choices.text: No, I will "clench my left hand."

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Ahaha! That's right! That's how things should be! And here I thought you two looked kind of weak. Didn't expect you to be this ruthless, to be honest!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, you'd be surprised.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (She just praised us... That doesn't feel right somehow, but at least she trusts us now.)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hah! It seems like you're no friends of Lyudochka either. That makes three of us... Anyway, what did she do to you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Huh, you know what? That's not actually untrue...)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Agh, that's rough. But fret not. She'll get what's coming to her soon enough, haha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why'd you say that?

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Well, it all comes back to what happened last week. I had to meet that woman at a restaurant. It was a mission, you understand. So, while she was paying for the meal, I rifled through her bags for a little spare change.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Wow. This person doesn't just say horrible stuff, she *is* horrible!)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hehe, but I made quite the unexpected find! And what a find it was!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you find?

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: A novel from Yae Publishing House. A new issue, fresh off the presses, too! As you know, the Teacher has always forbidden unnecessary leisure. So I reported her, of course.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hah! Never did I expect that the Teacher was already losing patience with her shilly-shallying on her assignment to infiltrate the "Iron Rats."

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: The Teacher was absolutely fuming after hearing my report. "I'm kicking her out of the shrine. She's going to Watatsumi Island to do some proper work!" Ah, that was great! Best thing I've heard all week!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Very well done indeed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}! You really sound like the bad guy here, you know?)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Hehehe. Whatever the case, let's eagerly await Lyudochka's tragic fall.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: What else do you need?

choices.text: She dumped her work onto us.

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: And what does your abandoning your homeland have to do with me? Wait. Are you stowaways? Well, if you're looking for my help, you're barking up the wrong tree!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Uh-oh, you must've used the wrong code back there. She's got a terrifying look on her face!)

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Leave! Or I'll set the Tenryou Commission's lackeys on you, and they'll lock you right up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're leaving! We're leaving!

response.speaker: Tae
response.text: Colleagues? You work here as well? Then what are you looking for me for? If you've got a problem, go find Mikawa Akane or something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(That's not the code we're going for, {NICKNAME}. Look, she's ignoring us now.)

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: How long have you been in Inazuma? Have you gotten used to life here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not long, really, but we're doing alright.

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: Good, good. Well, I suppose you've met those "General Crabs," then? Those people really know how to give us trouble.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: No kidding. Taxes used to be the worst thing ever around here in Ritou. They've actually gone down quite a lot after the recent abolition of the Vision Hunt Decree.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: On the downside... *sigh* You know what? It's probably due to that incident with our Lady. Vigilance is at an all-time high. We can't act rashly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ("Our Lady"... He must mean Signora.)

choices.text: Aye, what with the robberies and all.

response.speaker: Buzuleac
response.text: Robbery? Surely you jest. They're with the Shogunate. Surely they wouldn't do such things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Uh oh, he's getting suspicious! You must've mixed up the lines that were related to crabs!)

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Well, you're finally back. Did you manage to get any intel from them?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Momoyo the details of the intelligence you got from the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Hmph. Seriously, between the two of you talking over each other, your report was as clear as mud. But don't worry, I got the gist of it.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: So, the fake at the shrine is named Lyudochka. Her superior has actually been pushing her to make further contact with you, but for some reason, she hasn't acted yet.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: As such, this superior, whom they call "the Teacher," is going to give her a new assignment tonight. She will have to leave the shrine and go to Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's exactly how it is, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: The details of this operation in Watatsumi Island is key intelligence. We must find some way to get our hands on it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we don't know where they're going to meet up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We could follow her from the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: That is so. But given that the area near the Grand Narukami Shrine is filled with mountain paths, we're quite likely to lose her.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Wait just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Here. Use this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Isn't this one of those Bamboo Slips you get from the Fortune Slip Box?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: This is no ordinary Bamboo Slip. I've scattered some Shuumatsuban-made elemental powder on it. You can use Elemental Sight to see the traces left by the powder.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now. We'll pretend to draw a Bamboo Slip, and then take the opportunity to get the powder onto her. Hehe, leave it to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Stop waving that slip around! How are you supposed to identify the right target if that powder gets onto you as well, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Sorry! Paimon's sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Hmph. Anyway, this powder is somewhat toxic, so fiddle with it willy-nilly at your own risk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Momoyo seems really fierce, but she's actually a pretty nice person...)

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: Hey! Less jibber-jabber, more work! Any further delay and the sun's going to go down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we're going, we're going!

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: ...Hmph. What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: Yes? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing much.

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: Lyudochka must decide. Tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: What, need more detailed information? <color=#00E1FFFF>One of those three Fatui is disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>The other two operate in Inazuma City. One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, works in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs</color>. Got that?

dialogues.speaker: Momoyo
dialogues.text: What are you standing around for? Cadavers aren't that interesting — or are you interested in being used as raw materials to make one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask who you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: My name is Buzuleac, a merchant from Sumeru. I'm currently doing business in Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: But I've been on break recently, so if you're here to talk business, could you come back in a few days?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Buzuleac
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask your name?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you standing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enjoying the view?

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: If so, or if not... what is it to you?

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: Either way, not your business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Fujita
dialogues.text: Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: What? Who died and made you the boss of me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Tae
dialogues.text: Hmph!
